note: SuPreM (Swin-UNETR, AbdomenAtlas seg-supervised) token grids over the FULL Merlin abdominal CT set (25,489 real-HU NIfTI). Weights supervised_suprem_swinunetr_2100.pth (load: ckpt['net'], strip 'module.backbone.'). Preprocess: RAS -> ScaleIntensityRange(-175,250)->[0,1] -> Resize whole volume to 96^3; tap swinViT(x, normalize)[2] (/8 stage) -> (12,12,12,192). Stored fp16, already [T,H,W,C]. Organ-coherence on Merlin = 0.39 (n=6, best of the encoders we tested there). CAVEAT: SuPreM is natively a 96^3-ROI model; we resize the whole volume (off-distribution) instead of sliding-window tiling. Reusable asset: same dir serves all splits; splits differ only by id list (Merlin official Split: train/val->valid/test).
